verdict.rationale: Neon is a serverless Postgres and backend platform. In the MCP relationship it is the tool provider, publishing its own hosted MCP server for coding agents to connect to, not an MCP host or client that loads external servers. The evidence about the Neon MCP Server and the `neon mcp` installer covers the server role only, so it does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing shows the product itself, including the AI Gateway or SQL Editor assistant, plugging in third-party MCP servers. This call is borderline: if the AI Gateway or Functions were treated as an agent host, the axis would apply and the verdict would be none.
